notes.title: Demo online!
notes.content:
Trucker Joe 2 Demo Is Now Live – Play It and Share Your Feedback


We're excited to announce that the first playable demo of Trucker Joe 2 is now available on Steam.

This is your chance to dive into the world of Trucker Joe 2 and experience a preview of what the full game will offer.


We’d love your feedback
Your impressions are important to us as we continue development. We're especially interested in:

What you enjoyed

What felt unclear, unbalanced, or frustrating

Any bugs, crashes, or technical issues you encountered

You can share your thoughts in the Steam Community Hub, or contact us directly via 

https://discord.gg/nHZgQGEqsF


[hr][/hr]What’s next?
We’re actively working on the full game and will continue to improve and expand based on your feedback. Stay tuned for future updates and content reveals as we move closer to release.
[hr][/hr]
Try the demo now on our Steam page Thank you for playing and supporting the project.

— The Trucker Joe 2 Team
